state: Goal `core-uri-1-2`. Its floor check `dossier-core-uri-1-2` names 12 `Core\Uri` members. `buildQuery`, `compareTo`, `decodeComponent` and `encodeComponent` have all their feature proofs, and 8 still owe some. `Core\Uri` has its class card, so no member owes the `help` proof. The four encoder and decoder members' Rust tests in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uri.rs` now carry `covers:` markers, so `encodeFormValue` and `decodeFormValue` no longer owe the Rust side. A change to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/uri.rs` makes every `Core\Uri` bench figure stale. `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\Uri'` measures them again, and it runs after `bun nv verify` has rebuilt the binary. `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Uri' --no-perf` lists what each member still owes. An encoder's result can be three times its argument, and the allocator refuses it cleanly at the memory limit (`tests/hostile/core/Uri/encodeComponent/01-text-that-grows-three-times.nvs` step 6), so `encode` needs no budget question of its own.
